ddgan_repair_bimodal_chain_v1.description: Learn conditional reverse transitions and the final ancestral distribution through the public DDGAN API; explicitly scoped GPU0 research diagnostic of original gates, no ordinary qualification

host_definition.sampling_law: Public DDGAN [1,.9,.5,.05,.0001]; N(0,I) terminal start; fresh independent learned-MoG latent/kernel noise and Gaussian reverse noise at EVERY step; eight heldout time/observation transition panels
host_definition.training_law: independent D/G clean mixture draws, independent uniform per-row timestep 1..4; public DDGAN.forward_pair; predicted-clean G and public DDGAN.reverse with independent Gaussian eta; public adversarial loss+critic penalty+recipe prior regularization
